messages:
maria: Quick favor — can someone run a full onboarding benchmark for kite-12b (INT8) on pool-t4d-48? Target: p99 <= 450ms @ seq=1024 bs=1. Need nsys traces + per-op breakdown and memory profile.

alex: I can run a smoke today. What exact matrix do you want? seq_lens: 128/512/1024; batch sizes: 1/2/4? Tokenization: HF BPE?

maria: Yep — 128/512/1024 and bs 1/2/4. Use HF tokenizer, seed 42, and include a run with prefix-caching ON and OFF. Compare against our baseline orion-13b-quant.

jin: I'll take the detailed runs tomorrow morning and capture flamegraphs + kernel timing. Please point me at the prompt set.

maria: Prompts uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/kite-onboard/prompts.tar.gz. Also add a small synthetic long-tail set (random chat-history style) to stress KV cache.

perf-bot: queued job 18642 for kite-12b int8 smoke. ETA ~40m.

alex: Smoke done (t4d). Seq=1024 bs=1 int8: p50 120ms, p95 320ms, p99 480ms, mem 21.8GB. p99 slightly above target. nvprof/nsys shows attention kernels stalling and occasional memcpy spikes. Trace: s3://redwood-perf/traces/18642/nsys.kite.int8

jin: Sounds like thread/affinity could be the cause. Can you re-run with pinning + OMP tweaks:

```
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
export KMP_AFFINITY=granularity=fine,compact,1,0
./run_bench --model kite-12b --quant int8 --seq 1024 --bs 1 --trace nsys
```

and drop-profile for KV cache hotpath (enable --kv-hotpath).

alex: Re-ran with pinning + kv-hotpath. New numbers: p50 115ms, p95 300ms, p99 430ms, mem 20.6GB. Flamegraph uploaded.

maria: Nice improvement. Can you also run bs=2 and bs=4 to see batching behavior? If batching increases p99 less than ~1.5x we can accept throughput tradeoffs.

alex: Batch=2: seq=1024 p99 700ms, throughput ~2.1x. Batch=4: p99 1600ms (way high). So batching helps throughput but tail grows nonlinearly.

jin: Kernel-level note: runtime v1.12 introduces a fused-rotary kernel that should cut attention time by ~20% for these sizes. If we toggle fused-rotary we might bring p99 down further. Also memcpy spikes suggest host->device scheduling suboptimal; runtime trace shows occasional stream syncs.

maria: Actionable plan: jin to prototype runtime opt (fused-rotary toggle) + canary; alex to run canary on dedicated pool and post traces; I will update onboarding doc with pass/fail criteria (p99 <= 450ms @ seq=1024 bs=1 and mem < 22GB).

sam: @maria one more thing — Dedicated customers need validation under CPU-fallback (if CUDA OOM/failover). Can we add a cpu-fallback smoke to the canary?

maria: Good catch. Jin please add a quick cpu-fallback run to the canary matrix.

perf-bot: job 18642 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/18642/{bench.csv,nsys.kite.int8,flame.svg}

jin: I'll open the runtime PR today with perf numbers and a canary job definition. It will include opt-in guard rails and telemetry hooks.

alex: Once PR lands I'll run the dedicated canary and attach new nsys traces. If p99 <= 450ms on dedicated, we can mark kite-12b INT8 as preliminary PASS for onboarding.

maria: Thanks all. I'll schedule a short sync Wed 10:00 to review canary results and decide rollout.

:thumbsup: alex, jin, sam
